summary_en: Donate clean ones or sew them into bags and rags. The black bin is the last stop.
summary_fil: I-donate ang malinis o tahiin bilang bag at basahan. Ang itim ang huling destinasyon.
prep_en: Wash it :: Clean before giving away.|Donate or reuse :: Sew into bags, covers or rags.
prep_fil: Labhan :: Linisin bago ibigay.|I-donate o gamitin :: Tahiin bilang bag, takip o basahan.
reuse_en: If it's still usable, donate it or give it away|Sew it into shopping bags
reuse_fil: Kung magagamit pa, ipamigay o i-donate|Tahiin bilang shopping bag

summary_en: Donate or repair jeans. Old denim makes strong bags and patches.
summary_fil: I-donate o ipaayos ang maong. Nagagawang matibay na bag at tagpi ang lumang denim.
prep_en: Wash it :: Donations should be clean.|Donate or repair :: Patch holes or replace zippers.
prep_fil: Labhan :: Dapat malinis ang ido-donate.|I-donate o ipaayos :: Tagpian ang butas o palitan ang zipper.
reuse_en: If it's still usable, donate it or give it away|Make it into a bag or patches
reuse_fil: Kung magagamit pa, ipamigay o i-donate|Gawing bag o tagpi

summary_en: Put dirty rags in the black bin. Rags with paint, oil or solvent go to hazardous waste collection.
summary_fil: Ang maruming basahan ay sa itim. Ang may pintura, langis o solvent ay sa koleksyon ng mapanganib na basura.
prep_en: Check it :: Did it touch paint, thinner or oil?|Sort it :: Black bin; chemical rags go to hazardous collection.
prep_fil: Suriin :: Nadikitan ba ng pintura, thinner o langis?|Itapon :: Sa itim; ang may kemikal ay sa koleksyon ng mapanganib.
note_en: Rags soaked in oil or solvent can catch fire on their own; keep them in a closed metal can.
note_fil: Puwedeng kusang magliyab ang basahang babad sa langis o solvent; ilagay sa saradong lata.

summary_en: Fix a broken strap first. Worn-out slippers go in the black bin.
summary_fil: Ayusin muna ang naputol na strap. Ang lumang tsinelas ay sa itim na basurahan.
prep_en: Repair it :: Replacement straps are cheap at the market.|Sort it :: Black bin when worn out.
prep_fil: Ayusin :: Mura ang pamalit na strap sa palengke.|Itapon :: Sa itim kapag luma na.

summary_en: Replace a broken zipper or strap. Donate usable bags; the black bin is last.
summary_fil: Palitan ang sirang zipper o strap. I-donate ang magagamit pa; ang itim ang huli.
prep_en: Empty it :: Check all pockets.|Repair or donate :: Tailors replace zippers cheaply.
prep_fil: Ubusin ang laman :: Tingnan ang lahat ng bulsa.|Ipaayos o i-donate :: Mura magpapalit ng zipper sa mananahi.
reuse_en: If it's still usable, donate it or give it away
reuse_fil: Kung magagamit pa, ipamigay o i-donate

summary_en: A shoe repair shop can fix soles and stitching. Donate wearable pairs; the black bin is last.
summary_fil: Naaayos ng sapatero ang swelas at tahi. I-donate ang magagamit pa; ang itim ang huli.
prep_en: Repair it :: Bring it to a sapatero.|Donate it :: Tie pairs together.
prep_fil: Ipaayos :: Dalhin sa sapatero.|I-donate :: Itali nang magkapares.
reuse_en: If it's still usable, donate it or give it away
reuse_fil: Kung magagamit pa, ipamigay o i-donate

summary_en: Mend small holes. Worn-out socks can be dusters, then go in the black bin.
summary_fil: Tahiin ang maliliit na butas. Gawing pamunas ang luma, saka ilagay sa itim.
prep_en: Mend it :: Darn small holes.|Reuse it :: Use it as a duster or shoe cover.|Sort it :: Black bin when used up.
prep_fil: Tahiin :: Tahiin ang maliliit na butas.|Gamitin ulit :: Gawing pamunas o balot ng sapatos.|Itapon :: Sa itim kapag gamit na gamit na.

summary_en: Donate, repair or hand down clothes. Turn worn-out ones into rags before using the black bin.
summary_fil: I-donate, ipaayos o ipasa ang damit. Gawing basahan ang luma bago itapon sa itim.
prep_en: Wash it :: Donations should be clean.|Donate or repair :: Churches, charities and relatives take clothes.|Last resort :: Cut into rags, then the black bin.
prep_fil: Labhan :: Dapat malinis ang ido-donate.|I-donate o ipaayos :: Tumatanggap ang simbahan, charity at kamag-anak.|Huling paraan :: Gawing basahan, saka sa itim.
reuse_en: If it's still usable, donate it or give it away|Cut it into cleaning rags
reuse_fil: Kung magagamit pa, ipamigay o i-donate|Gawing basahan
reduce_en: Buy fewer, longer-lasting clothes; try ukay-ukay
reduce_fil: Bumili ng kaunti pero matibay; subukan ang ukay-ukay

summary_en: Animal shelters often welcome old towels. Otherwise, cut them into rags.
summary_fil: Madalas tumatanggap ng lumang tuwalya ang animal shelter. Kung hindi, gawing basahan.
prep_en: Wash it :: Clean before giving away.|Give or reuse :: Shelters, clinics or rags.
prep_fil: Labhan :: Linisin bago ibigay.|Ibigay o gamitin :: Sa shelter, clinic o gawing basahan.
reuse_en: Give it to an animal shelter|Cut it into rags

summary_en: Used underwear isn't donated. Put it in the black bin, or use clean old ones as rags.
summary_fil: Hindi idino-donate ang gamit na panloob. Ilagay sa itim, o gawing basahan ang malinis na luma.
prep_en: Wash it :: Clean it if you'll use it as a rag.|Sort it :: Black bin.
prep_fil: Labhan :: Linisin kung gagawing basahan.|Itapon :: Sa itim na basurahan.
